summary.en: An automated ETL pipeline that turns raw healthcare records into a star-schema warehouse and a Power BI dashboard. Built as a group project.
summary.id: Pipeline ETL otomatis yang mengubah data kesehatan mentah menjadi data warehouse star schema dan dashboard Power BI. Dikerjakan sebagai proyek kelompok.

problem.en: Raw healthcare records contained invalid entries and had to be cleaned, modeled, and refreshed before anyone could trust a dashboard built on them.
problem.id: Data kesehatan mentah mengandung entri tidak valid dan harus dibersihkan, dimodelkan, dan diperbarui sebelum dashboard di atasnya bisa dipercaya.

solution.en: Built an ETL pipeline with Pentaho Data Integration and MySQL that loads 55,500 records into a star-schema data warehouse, with multi-layer validation and an interactive Power BI dashboard on top. A 3-stage Pentaho job with error logging orchestrates the full refresh.
solution.id: Membangun pipeline ETL dengan Pentaho Data Integration dan MySQL yang memuat 55.500 record ke data warehouse star schema, dengan validasi berlapis dan dashboard Power BI interaktif di atasnya. Job Pentaho 3 tahap dengan error logging menjalankan seluruh proses refresh.

myRole.en: Built the ETL pipeline, the star-schema model, the validation rules, and the dashboard.
myRole.id: Membangun pipeline ETL, model star schema, aturan validasi, dan dashboard.

impact.en: Filtered out 21% invalid data before it reached the warehouse. The full refresh runs automatically in about 6 minutes.
impact.id: Menyaring 21% data tidak valid sebelum masuk ke warehouse. Refresh penuh berjalan otomatis dalam sekitar 6 menit.

alt.en: Power BI healthcare dashboard showing total encounters, total billing, high-risk encounters, average length of stay, risk distribution, average billing by condition, monthly visit trends, and patients by age group.
alt.id: Dashboard Power BI kesehatan berisi total kunjungan, total tagihan, kunjungan berisiko tinggi, rata-rata lama rawat, distribusi risiko, rata-rata tagihan per penyakit, tren kunjungan bulanan, dan pasien per kelompok usia.

summary.en: An interactive Tableau dashboard on a star-schema model that explains sales across 3 branches and 6 product lines. Built as a group project.
summary.id: Dashboard Tableau interaktif di atas model star schema yang menjelaskan penjualan di 3 cabang dan 6 lini produk. Dikerjakan sebagai proyek kelompok.

problem.en: Find which branches drive sales, and explain a 32% sales drop in mid-February.
problem.id: Menemukan cabang mana yang mendorong penjualan, dan menjelaskan penurunan penjualan 32% di pertengahan Februari.

solution.en: Modeled 1,000 transactions into a star schema and built a Tableau dashboard with dynamic metric switching, branch-split trends, and cross-view filtering.
solution.id: Memodelkan 1.000 transaksi menjadi star schema dan membangun dashboard Tableau dengan pergantian metrik dinamis, tren per cabang, dan cross-view filtering.

myRole.en: Built the data model and the dashboard, and ran the analysis.
myRole.id: Membangun model data dan dashboard, serta melakukan analisis.

impact.en: Identified Naypyitaw as the top branch ($110.6K) with the fewest transactions (328), meaning the highest spend per visit. Traced the mid-February drop to a system-wide slowdown across all six product lines rather than a single category.
impact.id: Menemukan Naypyitaw sebagai cabang teratas ($110,6K) dengan transaksi paling sedikit (328), artinya belanja per kunjungan tertinggi. Menelusuri penurunan pertengahan Februari ke perlambatan menyeluruh di keenam lini produk, bukan satu kategori saja.

alt.en: Tableau dashboard of supermarket sales, January to March 2019: profit, units sold, and transaction count, weekly profit trend, profit by product line and week, product line breakdown, and profit by branch city with Naypyitaw highest.
alt.id: Dashboard Tableau penjualan supermarket Januari sampai Maret 2019: profit, unit terjual, dan jumlah transaksi, tren profit mingguan, profit per lini produk dan minggu, rincian lini produk, serta profit per kota cabang dengan Naypyitaw tertinggi.

summary.en: Statistical analysis and a Random Forest price model on three months of Amazon India fashion orders, published as an interactive report. Built as a group project.
summary.id: Analisis statistik dan model harga Random Forest atas tiga bulan order fashion Amazon India, dipublikasikan sebagai laporan interaktif. Dikerjakan sebagai proyek kelompok.

problem.en: Find what drives revenue and order value, why orders fail, and whether promotions change what customers spend.
problem.id: Menemukan apa yang mendorong pendapatan dan nilai order, mengapa order gagal, dan apakah promosi mengubah belanja pelanggan.

solution.en: Cleaned 128,975 orders in pandas, ran Shapiro-Wilk, ANOVA, Kruskal-Wallis, chi-square and Mann-Whitney tests with effect sizes, fitted an OLS model, and trained a Random Forest tuned with randomized and grid search. An audit of the first version found and fixed ten analytical errors, including perfect multicollinearity and a confounded A/B comparison.
solution.id: Membersihkan 128.975 order dengan pandas, menjalankan uji Shapiro-Wilk, ANOVA, Kruskal-Wallis, chi-square, dan Mann-Whitney beserta effect size, membangun model OLS, dan melatih Random Forest yang di-tuning dengan randomized dan grid search. Audit terhadap versi pertama menemukan dan memperbaiki sepuluh kesalahan analisis, termasuk multikolinearitas sempurna dan perbandingan A/B yang terkonfound.

myRole.en: Ran the full analysis end to end, audited and revised the first version to correct ten analytical errors, and wrote the final interactive report.
myRole.id: Mengerjakan seluruh analisis dari awal hingga akhir, mengaudit dan merevisi versi pertama untuk memperbaiki sepuluh kesalahan analisis, serta menyusun laporan interaktif akhirnya.

impact.en: Sets bring in 50% of ₹70.3M revenue, Merchant-fulfilled orders fail 22.9% of the time against 13.0% for Amazon, and the apparent +₹65 promo effect shrinks to +₹11.5 once fulfilment and category are controlled for.
impact.id: Set menyumbang 50% dari pendapatan ₹70,3 juta, order yang dipenuhi Merchant gagal 22,9% dibanding 13,0% untuk Amazon, dan efek promo yang tampak +₹65 menyusut menjadi +₹11,5 setelah fulfilment dan kategori dikontrol.

alt.en: Amazon India fashion sales dashboard, 31 March to 29 June 2022: period, fulfilment, category and segment filters, key figures (₹70.3M revenue, 106,011 delivered orders, ₹663 mean order value, 16.0% failed orders, 72.3% with a promotion), a daily revenue chart peaking at ₹1,094,989 on 4 May 2022, and revenue by category led by Set at ₹35.0M.
alt.id: Dashboard penjualan fashion Amazon India, 31 Maret sampai 29 Juni 2022: filter periode, fulfilment, kategori, dan segmen, angka utama (pendapatan ₹70,3 juta, 106.011 order terkirim, rata-rata nilai order ₹663, 16,0% order gagal, 72,3% dengan promosi), grafik pendapatan harian dengan puncak ₹1.094.989 pada 4 Mei 2022, dan pendapatan per kategori dipimpin Set sebesar ₹35,0 juta.

alt.en: Case study page titled "What drives the value of a fashion order on Amazon India?", with section navigation (data, sales, failed orders, tests, promotions, model, conclusions) and an opening summary: product category alone explains 45% of the variation in order value.
alt.id: Halaman studi kasus berjudul "What drives the value of a fashion order on Amazon India?", dengan navigasi bagian (data, penjualan, order gagal, uji, promosi, model, kesimpulan) dan ringkasan pembuka: kategori produk saja menjelaskan 45% variasi nilai order.

title.en: Chillo: Smart Fridge & Food Waste Tracker

summary.en: A full-stack web app that tracks food expiry dates and logs spoiled items to cut household food waste. Built as a group project.
summary.id: Aplikasi web full-stack yang melacak tanggal kedaluwarsa makanan dan mencatat makanan basi untuk mengurangi sampah makanan rumah tangga. Dikerjakan sebagai proyek kelompok.

problem.en: Households lose track of what is in the fridge, so food expires unnoticed and money is wasted.
problem.id: Rumah tangga sering lupa isi kulkas, sehingga makanan kedaluwarsa tanpa disadari dan uang terbuang.

solution.en: Tracks expiry dates, sends automatic expiry alerts, and logs spoiled items. A waste analytics dashboard (Recharts) shows a Kitchen Score, financial loss estimates in IDR, and CSV export.
solution.id: Melacak tanggal kedaluwarsa, mengirim pengingat otomatis, dan mencatat makanan basi. Dashboard analitik sampah (Recharts) menampilkan Kitchen Score, estimasi kerugian dalam Rupiah, dan ekspor CSV.

myRole.en: Built and deployed the full stack with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, and MongoDB, including a REST API, session-based authentication, and Jest unit and integration tests.
myRole.id: Membangun dan men-deploy seluruh stack dengan Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, dan MongoDB, termasuk REST API, autentikasi berbasis sesi, serta unit dan integration test dengan Jest.

alt.en: Chillo Reports page: inventory snapshot (12 items, 10 safe, 1 expiring soon, 1 expired), financial impact of Rp 95,000 in wasted food, 3 items wasted, kitchen score 87/100, waste by category donut chart, cooked vs discarded bar chart, and a waste log table with CSV export.
alt.id: Halaman Reports Chillo: ringkasan inventaris (12 item, 10 aman, 1 segera kedaluwarsa, 1 kedaluwarsa), dampak finansial Rp 95.000 dari bahan terbuang, 3 item terbuang, kitchen score 87/100, diagram donat limbah per kategori, grafik batang dimasak vs dibuang, dan tabel waste log dengan ekspor CSV.
